observations: Apparent contradiction: PRED-367.H1 says the 1844 passage was 'suppressed—not by conspiracy, but by logical impasse', while PRED-843.H3 and PRED-859.H3 state a custodial suppression hypothesis (Soviet custody, Adoratsky substitution). The same word names two mechanisms.

The earlier 'Marx could not write the passage' form persists after #843's correction: PRED-38.H3's later statements from #846 (2026-06-17) and #1064 (2026-07-11) and PRED-858.H6 (#858, #1219, 2026-06-18) keep it, while #1065/#1066 (2026-07-11, under PRED-843.H1) say 'Marx may very well have written it'.

Apparent contradiction on the Soviet evidence for the Invariance Condition: #843 line 167 calls the Soviet Union 'the primary evidence for the condition'; #1067 line 99 says the Soviet case 'does not yet establish IC-3' and is evidence only for IC-1. PRED-367.G1's later statements also alternate between the scoped form (#846, historical claim, not a universal law) and the unscoped form (#1065, #1647).
